meta.title: feat: Optimize default channel migration for performance
meta.body_summary: Implement performance optimizations for default channel migration and API endpoints by replacing row-by-row processing with set-based operations, adding indexes, and consolidating database operations.

core_change_summary.description: Added optimized versions of channel API endpoints (get_optimized.ts, post_optimized.ts) and an optimized default channel migration SQL script. Changes include set-based operations instead of row-by-row processing, added indexes, array filtering for default channel identification, and consolidated database operations to reduce round-trips.
